answer: Each epoch auctions 20 work slots: every applicant vertex posts a 40 POA bid bond, and the top 20 bids win. A bid that mirrors another identity's funding trail is flagged as a copy, and both bonds burn, so one operator cannot clone bids across a nebula of fake accounts. A fake wanting 100 slots must lock 4,000 POA, while one honest agent posts a single 40 POA bond, refunded after 10 epochs, and keeps the full 25 POA slot reward undiluted.
